rationale: C12 is a concrete, material drafting template for the child. Both proclamations use the same section 22 cotton-quota framework and closely parallel the full sequence: prior quota and interference findings; supplemental Tariff Commission investigation, hearing, findings, and recommendation; presidential finding of changed circumstances; authorization of an additional cotton quantity limited to essential manufacturing needs; entry only under Tariff Commission licenses; a finding of no material interference with the domestic cotton program; Commission authority to provide equitable distribution; and immediate effectiveness. C14 also supplied highly similar and more current quota-year language, but it lacks the child's distinctive licensing and equitable-distribution machinery, which tracks C12 almost verbatim. C24 is a weaker antecedent for the updated quota-year and changed-circumstances language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the United States Tariff Commission has made a supplemental investigation ... after due notice, a public hearing was held ... parties interested were given opportunity to be present, to produce evidence, and to be heard
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the United States Tariff Commission has made a supplemental investigation ... after due notice, a public hearing was held ... parties interested were given opportunity to be present, to produce evidence, and to be heard
shared_material.explanation: C12 supplies a nearly verbatim procedural recital sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: do hereby find and declare ... that changed circumstances require the modification ... so as to permit ... an additional quantity up to but not exceeding ... pounds
shared_material.parent_excerpt: do hereby find and declare ... that changed circumstances require the modification ... so as to permit ... such additional quantity ... up to a total of 18,000,000 pounds
shared_material.explanation: The child reuses C12's operative finding-and-modification structure while changing the quantity, staple range, and quota dates.

shared_material.child_excerpt: no portion of such additional quantity of cotton shall be permitted entry ... except by or for the account of a person or firm engaged in cotton manufacturing to whom the Tariff Commission has issued a license and subject to the limitations specified in such license
shared_material.parent_excerpt: no portion of such additional quantity of cotton shall be permitted entry ... except by or for the account of a person or firm engaged in cotton manufacturing to whom the said Tariff Commission has issued a license and subject to the limitations specified in such license
shared_material.explanation: This distinctive licensing proviso is essentially verbatim and materially governs administration of the supplemental quota.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Tariff Commission is authorized to adopt such procedure and rules and regulations as it considers necessary to assure the equitable distribution ... among essential users
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Tariff Commission is authorized to adopt such procedure and rules and regulations as will assure the equitable distribution ... among essential users
shared_material.explanation: The child closely reproduces C12's delegation of equitable-distribution authority.
